raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (all 377 rows with source_tz='UTC') delivered txn_ts in UTC, while every other batch is in America/Chicago local time. Silver casts txn_ts without converting, so batch 13's Jan 17 evening transactions land on 2026-01-18 between 00:00 and 05:00. That creates the off-hours spike and misattributes transactions across dates in all gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
